decisions.reason: A complete same-message MODIFY already updates SQ12's shot_specification_method to detailed descriptions, optional online example frames, and an updated storyboard reel as an alternative.
A complete same-message MODIFY already records the revised reference format and storyboard-mismatch specification; no stale attribute requires removal.
A complete same-message MODIFY already updates SQ11's shot_specification_method with the detailed-description, example-frame, and optional updated-reel alternatives.
The source changes how SQ4 shots are specified, not the independently defined visual behavior of the SQ4 energy blast.
Changing the shot-specification reference format does not alter the existing set-image quality rules or their script-angle constraint.
The choice between detailed shot descriptions and an updated storyboard reel does not change the full-color final-video requirement.
The shot-specification method does not change the required vertical 9:16 output format.
The source does not alter the requirement that revised sets remain visually distinct from one another.
The source concerns a shot-direction communication method and does not change the existence, composition, or deferred status of the opening aerial shot.
The source does not revise the established pair counts, character allocation, or wide-to-mid-to-close framing progression.
Using detailed descriptions or reference frames does not change the requirement for stylistic continuity across set imagery.
The source does not alter which bridges must be removed or retained in the Kestrel images.
